# Corporate Law This is the law by which Nanotrasen enforces order upon the station.
## Escalation These are the general practices for escalation. Gross misconduct involving over-escalation may waive punishments that would otherwise go to a violator of Corporate Law. - Arresting: A violator of a Type 3 or less Violation must be hailed before being arrested, and is not to be violently arrested if complying, unless corporal punishment is to be issued. - Issuance of Corporal Punishment: If a violator of a Type 1 violation refuses to rectify the violation upon the first command to do so, and only if a command was issued, corporal punishment may then be applied. It is otherwise approved to do so immediately. - Authorization of lethal force: If an officer feels reasonable concern for their life, or the entitiy has violated a Type 4, 5, or non-standard Violation and is not complying.
## Definitions - Schedule A Narcotics - Minor and department restricted chemicals. - Schedule B Narcotics - Major restricted chemicals. - Pyrotechnic Chemicals - Flammable and explosive chemicals. - Employee, Nanotrasen Employee - Sentient beings who have a contract with Nanotrasen to serve as an employee aboard the station. - Foreign Agents - Any sentient humanoid which is not a violator of the Taboo Violations. - Command - Sentient Employees with command access assigned by Nanotrasen or appointed by the Captain. - Head of Staff - Members of command who reign over a specific department. - Captain - The Nanotrasen dictated captain of the station. Acting captains are not awarded the same rights as the Nanotrasen appointed one. - D-Class - Disposable Nanotrasen property to be utilized for experimentation, undesirable labor, and any other tasks. - Execution - A punishment of which the sentencing is dictated in the Mandate of the Captain Charter. Methods of execution always involve preventing revival through decapitation and collection of the head, incineration, or other methods that ultimately fully prevent revival.
